card.name: Dosing interval and frequency wording
card.fires_on: The word "Interval" after "Dosing" in dose tables, and words like "other" in "every other day" or "time" in "any time of the day". It responds where a dosing schedule or time span is being named.

modes.label: Dosing Interval header
modes.description: "Interval" right after "Dosing" in a dosage table column heading.
modes.example: mg Dosing<< Interval>> Every 24 hours Every 4

modes.label: Every other day
modes.description: "other" in "every other day" within renal dose adjustments.
modes.example: mg oral granules every<< other>> day 9 kg to <14

modes.label: Other timing words
modes.description: Words such as "time" or an infusion-duration number that describe when or how long.

card.writes: It likely pushes away continuations about time words and favors odd non-time tokens, so no clear output effect on dosing text.
card.plain: It lights up on the words that name how often a dose is given, like "Dosing Interval" or "every other day".
